task.title: Advance registered workflows through a caller-owned cursor
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/683 under decision https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/682 by adding pure in-memory advancement through an explicit authored transition index and exact gate acknowledgement.
acceptance_criteria: Start at the exact declared phase and expose the borrowed workflow and current phase without copying or mutating registry topology.
Make authored zero-based transition index and exact caller gate acknowledgement the only advancement authority.
Reject terminal, out-of-range, acknowledgement, missing start or target, and ambiguous start or target failures before cursor mutation.
Support cycles and repeated visits while adding no action invocation, automatic edge choice, external gate evaluation, provider or tool authority, scheduling, or persistence.

attempts.summary: Established RED kernel coverage for pure workflow advancement.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow_cursor test failed to compile because WorkflowCursor and WorkflowCursorError did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for exact borrowed start and current phase, repeated-target authored edges, gated and ungated acknowledgement, typed atomic failures, malformed topology resolution, terminal phases, and cyclic repeated visits.

attempts.diagnostic: Resolving the selected authored edge, acknowledgement contract, and exact target before updating the phase index made every failure atomic and kept the cursor a pure process-local state projection.
attempts.patch: Added borrowed WorkflowCursor, typed start, transition, gate, and target errors, ADR-0008, behavior documentation, and milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Preserved the exact head through a rate-limited false green and recorded substantive review rationale.
attempts.diagnostic: The initial review status was rate limited and therefore insufficient; after cooldown and one budget-checked resume, CodeRabbit substantively identified duplicated unique-phase lookup as a non-blocking maintainability nit rather than a correctness defect.
attempts.patch: Kept head c34b8cbc3120a3e6f6a5e35757726563aeb8231c unmerged until the Rust gate, substantive exact-head review, and zero unresolved threads were confirmed; retained the bounded implementation because the suggested helper refactor was optional and behavior was fully verified.

outcome.summary: A caller can now move one borrowed process-local cursor through exact authored transitions with explicit gate acknowledgement while every invalid move leaves the current phase unchanged.

lessons: Authored transition indexes preserve duplicate-target edge identity without inventing target-text selection semantics.
Gate acknowledgement is exact caller-provided evidence, not external gate evaluation or permission delegation.
Resolving all transition preconditions and the exact target before mutation makes cursor failures atomic.
Cycles require no special executor semantics when the cursor only projects caller-selected in-memory state.
Pure advancement changes one phase index and grants no provider, tool, action, scheduling, persistence, or permission authority.
